section_header: EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEMS — Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) System
title: EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEMS — Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) System

content.description: Ohmmeter connected to VSV (Vacuum Switching Valve) connector for short circuit check. Shows ohmmeter with Ω symbol connected to a connector and VSV component.

content.text: Using an ohmmeter, check that there is no continuity between the terminals and the VSV body.
If there is continuity, replace the VSV.

content.description: Ohmmeter connected to VSV connector terminals for open circuit/resistance check. Shows ohmmeter with Ω symbol connected to a connector and VSV component.

content.text: Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between the terminals.
If the resistance is not within specification, replace the VSV.

items:
REMOVE EGR VALVE
Check the valve for sticking and heavy carbon deposits.
If a problem is found, replace it.
INSTALL EGR VALVE WITH NEW GASKET
